market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$64,707, down 1.11% on Jul 17. Failed twice to break $65K resistance (Jul 15-16 highs ~$65,100-$65,471). Up ~7% in July from June lows (~$60K). Still -30% from Jan 2026 highs above $93K.
market_summary.sentiment: Fear & Greed Index recovering from lows but still fragile. Social volume at 41,800 daily comments - second lowest since Oct 2024. Neither panicked nor euphoric. Neutral to cautiously bearish.
market_summary.macro: Jun CPI (Jul 14): softer than expected - main bullish catalyst for current partial recovery. PPI declined 0.3% MoM. Fed rate at 3.50-3.75%, hawkish tone. FOMC raised dot plot median to 3.8% for year-end. No rate cuts expected in 2026.
market_summary.etf_flows: Spot BTC ETFs: $4.13B net outflows over 30 days despite small $10M recent inflow. Institutional sentiment cooled; large allocators waiting for clearer macro signals.
market_summary.resistance_support: Key resistance: $65,700-$65,800 (must break for trend reversal). Support: $63,000-$63,500 (daily pivot ~$63,445). Deeper support $58,000-$59,000.
market_summary.regulatory: SEC added 3 crypto rulemaking items to 2026 agenda (Jul 7): crypto asset sales, custody rules, market-structure changes. White House opposed FIT21 bill - regulatory uncertainty remains.
